title: AI Pop Art Generator
summary: Make pop art with AI: Ben-Day dots, thick black outlines, flat primary colours and silkscreen repeats. Describe it, pick a pop art style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make pop art with AI?


Describe the subject, then the printed look: thick black outlines, Ben-Day dots and a few flat primary colours, such as a woman sipping a soda in red, cyan and yellow with halftone shadows, then pick a pop art style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the picture into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into pop art?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for a pop art portrait of it with thick black outlines, Ben-Day dots and flat bright colours, keeping the same pose and framing.


### How do I make a four-panel pop art portrait?


Ask for a silkscreen grid of four panels, two by two, with the same subject in each and a different clashing colour scheme per panel, plus uneven ink and slight misregistration for the screen-printed feel.


### What are Ben-Day dots?


Ben-Day dots are the evenly spaced coloured dots that cheap comic printing used to make tints and skin tones; pop artists painted them by hand at a large scale, and naming them in a prompt brings that printed texture back.


### Is the pop art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
